subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Man i. irrational by nature. b. Peace and amity are ii. of his duties and rights. c. We should be iii. self centered. d. Education makes a man conscious iv. his livelihood. e. Man himself earns v. prerequisite for living in society. vi. is social being. vii. respectful to others.
guide_solution: (a + vi) : Man is social being. (b + v) : Peace and amity are prerequisite for living in society. (c + vii) : We should be respectful to others. (d + ii) : Education makes a man conscious of his duties and rights. (e + iv) : Man himself earns his livelihood.
